headline: McDonald's US Sales Decline for First Time in Six Quarters
summary: McDonald's US same-store sales declined for the first time in six quarters as the burger chain tested value meals to win back lower-income diners.
why: McDonald's is the world's largest fast-food chain, making its same-store sales a key proxy for consumer discretionary spending health among lower-income demographics.

impacts.name: McDonald's
impacts.why: A sales decline directly signals weaker retail restaurant demand and consumer spending pressure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A decline in domestic sales growth challenges consumer spending resilience assumptions in the retail restaurant sector.
